memories.content: The group has agreed to collect money for cast flowers and hand them over backstage before curtain. They have a collection pot and a plan to coordinate. They are aware of the Friday 19:00 curtain time.

Petersfield Secondary's play opening night is Friday at 19:00. The parents' group is responsible for collecting for cast flowers and handing them over backstage before curtain. The group has access to the school and backstage area.
